Messages.Author: gymim
Messages.Body: is there a detailed rule area on vekn that i can look up the full details of the "no repeat action" rule that details what vampires can do, in regards to multiple actions?

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Page 20 of the rulebook:

A minion cannot perform an action with the same action card more than once each turn, even if they unlocks.
A minion cannot perform each action via the same card in play (including from the minion’s own card text) more than once each turn, even if they unlock.

This limitation kicks in when the action reaches resolution, that is when it is either blocked (unsuccessful) or not (successful).

In some rare cases (Tangle Atropo's Hand), the action is canceled before resolution and can be performed again.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: Timo
Messages.Body:
I would add that some types of action add another kind of NRA :
Rulebook p 20 :

A minion cannot perform more than one bleed action each turn.

Rulebook p 23 :
A vampire cannot perform more than one political action each turn.
